title: CEDATA GPGE Patient Registry - Registry for chronic inflammatory bowel diseases in children and adolescents
summary: The CEDATA-GPGE registry was developed to collect and analyze routine clinical data relating to the disease, diagnosis, treatment and progression of children and adolescents with chronic inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The knowledge gained from this registry should provide a comprehensive insight into the care situation in Germany and Austria, as well as in Switzerland in the future, and improve the diagnosis and treatment of affected patients.

interventions.name: Health Care Data is entered into an online environment and feedback is given to the treatment centers

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD)
Exclusion criteria:
No chronic inflammatory bowel disease, age of majority, lack of consent from legal guardian, lack of consent from patient over the age of 12
